Shaped iteration 0115 as one benchmark task to prepare the complete WP1 text, preservation and answer key for independent checking.
The [0114 record](history/records/0114.json) confirms #561 was accepted and merged; its [provenance](../benchmark/writing/review-0113-provenance.md) closes the review-preservation handoff.
The next substantive gap is explicit in the [WP1 requirements](../benchmark/writing/README.md) and [protocol](../benchmark/protocol.md): source-derived expectations and frozen inputs must precede either arm.
The [task graph](tasks.json) assigns benchmark/default/high, 90 minutes and 65 turns, with no dependencies.
Four new files will hold per-ID expectations, prompt/input manifests, independent-check instructions and a repository-only integrity/coverage checker with actual results.
Independent approval remains pending; that checker cannot certify narrative truth or replace a separate checker.
No session can run LabVIEW; native validity, behavior, build and save-version authority remain unresolved.
The graph orders no project edit, agent trial, product implementation, evaluator change or owner request.
Read the graph back and checked required sections, permitted role/model/limits, explicit output scope and its single plain Python verification command; no shell execution was available to this role.
Updated [working memory](../journal/working-memory.md) with evidence boundaries and the next cold-session instruction.
After accepted key authorship, independently check the pinned key against original evidence; do not repeat completed integration reviews or infer readiness from preparation checks.
Startup diagnostics were healthy, with an estimated 14,293 tokens.
